critique_history.assessment:
- The cabinet and door render as pale copper/peach, not dark brown; use substantially darker, less reflective brown materials.
- The background is black instead of plain white; explicitly disable film transparency and configure a white world.
- Bright trim-like reflections overwhelm the top and door edges; increase roughness and simplify the perimeter detailing.
The compact cube form, dark glass top, front door, and attached right-side vertical metallic handle are all clearly represented.
